title: Jiwa Nyang Teusiksa Krueng Nil .
intro: Lam masa peundjadjahan njang rajek that, watèë sidroë tiran djipeurintah nanggroë deungon keujam njang mutlak, sidroë jiwa djipiléh djalan iman ateuëh keunyamanan keurajaan. Tokoh nyoe tinggai lam ate kuasa teuma meurumpok keubeunaran lam peusan sidroe nabi nyang miyueb até. Perjalanan awaknyan akan jeuet keu saboh peulajaran nyang abadi lam kesabaran, pengorbanan, dan keyakinan nyang hana meugoyang. Jeuet gata taidentifikasi individu nyang luar biasa nyoe nyang leubeh galak keunikmatan ilahi nibak status donya?
clues: Lon tinggai lam meuligoe nyang rayeuk, bah pih meunan até lon meuteumé keubeunaran lam saboh peusan nyang miyueb até.
Lon pileh untuk ikot bimbingan Musa, lon teupeu akibat yang akan lon hadapi.
Lon meukawen ngon tiran nyang paleng meukuasa bak masa lon, bahpih meunan lon tulak dewa-dewa palsu gobnyan.
Deurita ulôn brat that, sabab ulôn teuhuköm sabab ulôn meuiman ubak Allah nyang Esa.
Lon hana tom meu-ulang-ulang lam iman lon, bahpih watee lon hadapi siksaan nyang paleng brat.
Tuhan lon galak keu saba lon dan geupiléh lon keu teumpat nyang mulia lam syuruga.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Meuprang bak djalan Allah deungon teuntra .
Peudong teumpat-teumpat seumayang di nanggroe Meusé .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Geupimpén ureuëng Israel geupeuteubiet nibak nanggroe Meusé .
Ka syahid dan geu mulia le Allah .
outcome.answer: Ka syahid dan geu mulia le Allah .

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
